data.title: TCS Q1 results after party: Infosys, Wipro, other IT stocks jump up to 4%. Why are analysts bullish despite AI worries?

Brokerages turned optimistic, citing resilient margins, improving demand outlook, attractive valuations and growing AI-led opportunities, despite lingering concerns over discretionary spending and macroeconomic uncertainty.

data.title: Dr. Reddy's Lab among 4 F&O stocks that saw a high increase in futures open interest
data.summary: Futures open interest rose over 11% in nine NSE F&O stocks on July 9, led by Dr. Reddy’s, Lodha Developers, Mazagon Dock and HDFC Life, signalling fresh trader participation.

data.title: Vedanta Aluminum shares to see 22% rally? Motilal Oswal initiates coverage with Buy, lists key tailwinds
data.summary: Motilal Oswal initiated coverage on Vedanta Aluminum with a buy rating. The brokerage set a target price of Rs 540 per share, which implies an upside potential of approximately 22%. The company is expected to experience strong earnings growth and cash flow generation. Vedanta Aluminum is approaching a significant earnings inflection point.

data.title: Kalyan Jewellers stock to double from here? Why analysts are bullish
data.summary: Kalyan Jewellers reported strong first-quarter revenue growth despite market headwinds. The company's international business and digital platform also showed significant expansion. Analysts are bullish, with some predicting the stock could double in value. Technical indicators suggest a positive medium-term outlook for the stock. Investors will monitor future showroom launches and festive season demand.

data.title: Eight men indicted in planned drone, sniper attack on White House UFC cage-fighting show
data.summary: One of the defendants told investigators that they planned to fly explosive-laden drones into the event and then shoot panicked crowd members as they fled, according to a federal affidavit.

data.title: Uttarakhand rains trigger flash flood risk in Dehradun: Rivers overflowing; Nainital, other districts on IMD's red alert
data.summary: Uttarakhand rains have triggered a flash-flood risk in Dehradun and other districts, with rivers flowing near the danger mark. Multiple districts, including Nainital, are on IMD red alert today.

data.title: Rs 6 lakh crore wealth boost! Sensex rallies 828 points, Nifty closes above 24,200. 5 key factors behind D-Street rally
data.summary: Indian stock markets experienced significant gains on Friday, with major indices closing higher. TCS reported strong first-quarter earnings, boosting sentiment across the information technology sector. Positive global market trends and resilient investor sentiment also contributed to the upward movement. Broader markets and various sectoral indices, including PSU banks and realty, saw substantial advances. Despite geopolitical tensions, the market demonstrated a confident and resilient trading performance.

data.title: Gold prices fall to Rs 1.44 lakh/10 gram; silver dips Rs 6,300 this week as Iran war raises inflation worries. What’s next?
data.summary: Gold prices slipped while silver edged higher on the MCX on Friday, supported by a weaker U.S. dollar. However, both precious metals remained on track for weekly losses as escalating U.S.-Iran tensions fuelled inflation concerns and strengthened expectations of tighter U.S. Federal Reserve policy.

data.title: Swiggy among 5 stocks flashing bullish signals, hinting at a possible uptrend
data.summary: SS Desc: A White Marubozu is a bullish candlestick pattern that forms when the opening price is the lowest and the closing price is the highest for a given trading session.

data.title: TCS shares jump over 3% after Q1 results. What are Morgan Stanley, Citi and other brokerages saying?
data.summary: TCS shares climbed 3.5% after the IT major reported a 5% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 net profit to Rs 13,349 crore and a 14% increase in revenue. While most brokerages retained their ratings, views remained mixed on the outlook, with optimism over AI-led growth offset by concerns around weak discretionary spending, margins and global macro uncertainty.

data.title: Vedanta Aluminium, Adani Power, 4 other stocks with up to 24% upside. Do you own any?
data.summary: Several brokerages have initiated coverage on Indian stocks, forecasting significant upside potential. Vedanta Aluminium and Adani Power are among the companies with positive outlooks. Uno Minda and Blue Star also show strong growth prospects for investors. Aequs and Aditya Infotech are highlighted for their manufacturing and market leadership. These selections offer investors potential gains based on analyst recommendations.

data.title: Korea's pain will be India's gain? Why Nifty bears betting on Kospi crash may get disappointed
data.summary: Foreign investors pulled ₹1.92 lakh crore from India in 2026 to chase the East Asian AI chip boom. As South Korea's KOSPI experiences wild swings, Nifty bulls are hoping that a capital rotation will send those funds rushing back to Dalal Street. But experts warn the road ahead won't be that simple.

data.title: Apollo Micro Systems shares rally 5% on Rs 1,550 crore deal to acquire 41% stake in Premier Explosives
data.summary: Apollo Micro Systems shares gained 5% after it sought to acquire Premier Explosives' promoters' stake for Rs 1,550 crore. This strategic acquisition aims to enhance capabilities in defence and aerospace sectors. The transaction is expected to conclude by December 2026 after necessary approvals. Apollo Micro Systems will also make a mandatory open offer to public shareholders. This move strengthens India's defence manufacturing and indigenous ecosystem.

data.title: Kalyan Jewellers among 4 stocks closed above VWAP, signalling bullish shift
data.summary: On July 9, four stocks in the Nifty500 pack rallied more than 2.5% above their Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP), according to StockEdge's technical scan data. Trading above the VWAP is widely regarded as a bullish technical signal, reflecting strong buying interest and indicating the potential for further upside.

data.title: Anand Rathi shares in focus after Q1 net profit jumps 24%, AUM crosses Rs 1 lakh crore
data.summary: Anand Rathi Wealth reported a 24% year-on-year rise in Q1FY27 profit after tax, driven by an 18% increase in revenue as assets under management crossed the Rs 1 lakh crore milestone. Strong net inflows, client additions and steady growth across its wealth management businesses supported the quarterly performance.

data.title: China shoe factory fire kills 28 in one of deadliest blazes in recent years; Xi Jinping voices worry on work safety
data.summary: Chinese leader Xi Jinping aired worries about repeated deadly workplace accidents after a blaze at a shoe factory killed 28 people.

data.title: US-Iran war: Israel shared intel of Iran plotting to assassinate Trump; fighting escalates in West Asia | Top updates
data.summary: The US and Iran have once again traded strikes days after IRGC attacked a commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. While Trump declared the ceasefire is over, US official said that technical talks will continue. On the other hand, Israel warned Washington of Tehran's plan to assassinate Trump

data.title: Kaynes Technology among 5 stocks showing bullish RSI upswing
